entries.title: Proverbs 2:1
segments: ¶My son, if you receive my words, And treasure my commands within you,

entries.title: Proverbs 2:2
segments: So that you incline your ear to wisdom, [And] apply your heart to understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:3
segments: Yes, if you cry out for discernment, [And] lift up your voice for understanding,

entries.title: Proverbs 2:4
segments: If you seek her as silver, And search for her as [for] hidden treasures;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:5
segments: Then you will understand the fear of the LORD, And find the knowledge of God.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:6
segments: For the LORD gives wisdom; From His mouth [come] knowledge and understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:7
segments: He stores up sound wisdom for the upright; [He is] a shield to those who walk uprightly;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:8
segments: He guards the paths of justice, And preserves the way of His saints.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:9
segments: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, Equity [and] every good path.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:10
segments: ¶When wisdom enters your heart, And knowledge is pleasant to your soul,

entries.title: Proverbs 2:11
segments: Discretion will preserve you; Understanding will keep you,

entries.title: Proverbs 2:12
segments: To deliver you from the way of evil, From the man who speaks perverse things,

entries.title: Proverbs 2:13
segments: From those who leave the paths of uprightness To walk in the ways of darkness;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:14
segments: Who rejoice in doing evil, [And] delight in the perversity of the wicked;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:15
segments: Whose ways [are] crooked, And [who are] devious in their paths;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:16
segments: To deliver you from the immoral woman, From the seductress [who] flatters with her words,

entries.title: Proverbs 2:17
segments: Who forsakes the companion of her youth, And forgets the covenant of her God.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:18
segments: For her house leads down to death, And her paths to the dead;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:19
segments: None who go to her return, Nor do they regain the paths of life-

entries.title: Proverbs 2:20
segments: So you may walk in the way of goodness, And keep [to] the paths of righteousness.

entries.title: Proverbs 2:21
segments: For the upright will dwell in the land, And the blameless will remain in it;

entries.title: Proverbs 2:22
segments: But the wicked will be cut off from the earth, And the unfaithful will be uprooted from it.
